description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/Viagra.csv' is already open in Jamovi. This dataset is from a pharmacological study (Field, 2013) examining the effect of Viagra dose on libido. Variables: 'dose' (1=Placebo, 2=Low dose, 3=High dose), 'libido' (self-reported libido score, 1-9), and 'partnerLibido' (partner's libido score). Click 'ANOVA' in the top menu bar and select 'One-Way ANOVA'. Move 'libido' to the 'Dependent Variable' box and 'dose' to the 'Grouping Variable' box. Under 'Variances', select 'Assume equal (Fisher's)'. Under 'Post Hoc Tests', select the 'Tukey (equal variances)' option. Under 'Additional Statistics', enable 'Descriptives table'.
